This Folio adaptation, including all part-*.json files in this directory, is distributed under the same CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported license. No endorsement is implied. The accompanying LICENSE.txt is verbatim from the source package.
Changes: converted the selected TEI dictionary to normalized UTF-8 JSON key/sense groups; preserved source spelling, sense-specific translations, glosses and available pronunciations; expanded POS labels; unwrapped Wiktionary text links; collapsed duplicate variants; moved explicitly archaic/obsolete senses after current senses; added normalized lookup indexing and immutable shards. Number of source articles: 62,181. Number of distinct case-normalized lookup headwords: 57,076. The original is not a token-by-token or context-aware machine translator. No OCR, AI translation or private texts are used to build this pack.
